actor: AI lab's chief financial officer and financial-reporting leadership
job: Rebuild three years of company accounts into audit-ready statements with a defensible revenue recognition policy across API, cloud and model-licensing income.
outcome: An audited annual revenue figure for the lab, disclosed in a Shanghai STAR Market listing document for the first time.
motivation: A STAR prospectus requires three years of audited accounts; without them the filing target the board set for this year cannot be met.

task.who: Financial reporting and controllership staff under the finance chief
task.what: Restate three years of accounts to listing disclosure standards
task.where: Internal close process and the group consolidation ledger
task.why: No audited history means no acceptable filing
task.how: PRC accounting standards applied to prior self-funded periods

actor: AI lab's technology cost accounting and research-expense reporting function
job: Separate cluster, GPU-hour and training-run spending from the founder's quantitative fund infrastructure so research and development can stand as its own expense line.
outcome: An itemized research and development expense line in the listing document, with compute and training costs attributable to the lab alone.
motivation: The lab's reputation rests on a training-cost claim no outsider could check; the expense line is where that claim becomes verifiable.

task.who: Cost accountants working with compute infrastructure and platform engineering
task.what: Attribute shared cluster and training spend to the lab
task.where: Cost allocation review across shared data-centre and cluster records
task.why: Capital intensity behind the models must be stated
task.how: GPU-hour and depreciation allocation against training run logs

actor: Issuer-side securities counsel and corporate restructuring advisers
job: Convert the company into a joint-stock issuer and regularize a shareholder register assembled in two rapid rounds so a filing is legally admissible.
outcome: A filing-eligible corporate structure with the founder's fund relationship disclosed as related-party dealing rather than an undocumented funding arrangement.
motivation: Years of funding through the founder's own fund leave related-party history that must be documented before the exchange will accept an application.

task.who: Securities counsel with company secretary and shareholder-relations staff
task.what: Document related-party history with the founder's quantitative fund
task.where: Joint-stock conversion process and shareholder register review
task.when: H2 2026 share-reform window ahead of the filing
task.why: Undocumented self-funding history blocks an exchange application
task.how: Legal due diligence against STAR Market listing rules

actor: Registered accounting firm's audit engagement partner and fieldwork team
job: Audit three years of a previously unaudited private lab and issue an opinion covering its revenue and its research and compute spending.
outcome: A signed audit report on three years of statements, making the revenue figure and research expense line usable in a listing document.
motivation: The opinion carries the firm's own liability, so the compute cost basis behind a widely cited cheap-training claim has to survive testing.

task.who: Audit engagement team with information-technology and valuation specialists
task.what: Test revenue recognition and the compute cost basis
task.where: Audit fieldwork at the lab and its data-centre suppliers
task.why: An unsupported cost basis cannot receive a clean opinion
task.how: Sampling of supplier contracts, invoices and cluster utilization records

actor: Sponsor institution's STAR Market listing execution and underwriting team
job: Run issuer due diligence and draft the prospectus, including the use of proceeds, then submit the application to the Shanghai exchange.
outcome: A submitted and publicly posted STAR Market listing document carrying the lab's audited revenue figure and its research expense line.
motivation: The sponsor is liable for the accuracy of what it files, and its fee arrives only when the application is accepted.

task.who: Sponsor representatives with capital markets and industry-research staff
task.what: Draft the prospectus and file it with the exchange
task.where: Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market application and review system
task.when: H2 2026 drafting through the H1 2027 filing runway
task.why: Sponsor liability attaches to every disclosed financial figure
task.how: STAR Market prospectus template and sponsor due-diligence checklist
